scope_of_pass: Design is sufficiently specified to proceed to an approval-ready sprint; this is not an implementation, compiler, game-balance or publication approval.

resolved_blockers.evidence: Normative appendix names exported pure calls, State/Config/Step/AdvanceResult contents, closed Event and Error variants, seven operation payloads, proposal canonical field order, a golden proposal and separate consumer/codec fixtures. The sprint assigns interface, strict codec and evidence gates to S1/S3.

One authoritative integer clock per Session, ordered dueTick/phase/objectId boundaries, explicit host-delivered cross-session input, and narrowly stated partition/continuation invariance remove the cross-clock numeric-order error.

Accepted (id, canonicalBody) entries never evict; capacity refuses new IDs while exact duplicates remain no-ops. Inventory conservation and named consumption sinks are separated from renewable work-allocation capacity, with staged aggregate validation.

strongest_remaining_objection: The proposed boundary still uses schematic type signatures and gives a full field-order golden only for proposals. Event variant payload encodings, state encoding, and the Host principal representation need exact exported definitions during S1/S3; otherwise an implementation could pass its own round trips while consumer expectations drift.
required_sprint_checks: Compile a separate consumer against the exported AILANG types and calls, including Host versus Actor principals and Conditional requirements.
Check fixed golden bytes for each proposal operation, event kind and error code; document event/state encoding order and version tags before treating the wire boundary as frozen.
Test task acceptance rather than pending offers for aggregate affordability, because OfferTask itself reserves nothing.
Demonstrate no-knowledge observers cannot see private evidence or emit effects on another actor's dimensions; validate policy outputs as one transaction.
Report actual LOC/time and split scope if the 2500-LOC, eight-day estimate threatens boundary tests or the second domain.

scope_assessment.pure_reusable_package: Pass: host-defined Config/Policies, no game/provider dependency, and an unrelated community consumer are appropriate reuse checks.
scope_assessment.directed_trust_and_policy: Pass: observer-specific evidence and outgoing relationship limits prevent global trust propagation; callbacks are explicitly trusted pure host code.
scope_assessment.dynamic_ai_claim: Pass: the text says live AI generation/provider routing is deferred. Recorded structured proposals and the standalone runner test the acceptance boundary only.
scope_assessment.player_agency: Pass: no overall score, optimum or mandated balancing policy is introduced; example trajectories are described as fixtures rather than balance proof.
scope_assessment.delivery_estimate: Plausible as a provisional plan after narrowing to one clock, though strict codec and separate consumer work leave little margin. The sprint includes review buffer and evidence gates.

decision: The round-one architectural blockers are resolved at design level. Proceed to user approval of the sprint, then implement only within that approved scope.
